response.answer: Prof. Ian Tattersall is a renowned British-American paleoanthropologist known for his influential research on early human dispersals and Pleistocene population dynamics in western Europe. He is Curator Emeritus at the American Museum of Natural History. His work includes significant contributions to understanding ancient human populations.
